canDoYue: 你識開會講更新，仲識禮貌咁同意或者講出擔心。
canDoEn: Share an update, agree politely, and name an action item.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨各位，我哋而家開會，分享今日議程上一個短更新。
dialogue.say: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item today.
dialogue.glossYue: 更新係期限改咗，我擔心我哋今日完成唔到呢項行動。
dialogue.say: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item today.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以再講多啲個期限，同埋開返咪等我哋聽到更新？
dialogue.say: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明白你嘅意思，但係我擔心負責人星期五趕唔切呢個新期限。
dialogue.say: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋同意星期五，負責人收會之前可以分享下一個更新。
dialogue.say: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.
dialogue.glossYue: 我同意星期五，但我建議靜音旁邊個傾計，而家跟返議程。
dialogue.say: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I see your point about the chat, and we can mute it before the action item.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明白你講傾計嗰點，我哋可以喺行動項之前靜音。
dialogue.say: I see your point about the chat, and we can mute it before the action item.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Let's wrap up now, and the owner will share the update after the next meeting on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋而家收會，負責人會喺星期五下次會之後分享更新。
dialogue.say: Let's wrap up now, and the owner will share the update after the next meeting on Friday.
